title: Constant-Footprint Corpus Commitment via Merkle Mountain Range Covenants and Append-Only Mountain Updates Across Heterogeneous Distributed Ledgers (SQUIRL-OS-IP-013, Provisional Draft)
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Errors are disclosed, not erased. This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All payloads synthetic; no customer-identifiable data appears in this record (POL-DISC-001).

Provisional patent draft SQUIRL-OS-IP-013: "Constant-Footprint Corpus Commitment via Merkle Mountain Range Covenants and Append-Only Mountain Updates Across Heterogeneous Distributed Ledgers." A whole-corpus cryptographic commitment system: the complete tracked state of an evidence repository is folded into a Merkle Mountain Range (fully specified, domain-separated construction: leaf SHA-256(0x00||SHA-256(file)); node SHA-256(0x01||left||right); bagged peaks right-to-left; root SHA-256(0x03||bag||leaf_count_u64_LE)) whose single 32-byte root is the corpus's entire on-chain representation, anchored in a fixed 37-byte protocol envelope across ten heterogeneous mainnet rails. The on-chain footprint is constant regardless of corpus size; corpus growth is discharged as append-only mountain updates while every prior root remains sealed on-chain; any single artifact stays verifiable from the public corpus, one anchored root, and a logarithmic inclusion path.

Reduction to practice: MCR-1 (2026-10-19) folded the 1,891-file four-horsemen evidence corpus at commit 7c492528 into root 2d1a32145cf89a6b7909d3059abe560e6f3d908e7d510525f4457e096f2cc23a anchored across all ten certified rails (BTC, XRP, ETH, SOL, ADA, ALGO, AVAX, DOT, DOGE, XLM), byte-exact keyless read-back on each (public ledger entry 0260). The MMR construction was re-validated byte-exact against the frozen root immediately before this publication. The MCR-2 mountain-update ceremony (this record's companion) grows the corpus to include this patent record and re-anchors the new root across the same ten rails, binding this DOI into the corpus commitment. Companion filings: SQUIRL-IP-011 (Caging the Large Language Model) and SQUIRL-OS-IP-012 (Multi-Rail Non-Custodial Evidence Anchoring); payload doctrine in thesis v2.1 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23482978, Section 2.5) and routing chapter (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23485222).

Scope and honesty: the chain stores the constant-size integrity commitment, not the corpus; the corpus itself lives off-chain and may be arbitrarily large — the commitment ("the entire internet fits in one root") is a statement about the 32-byte fingerprint, not on-chain storage. Patent-then-publish doctrine: this is a provisional draft for filing, published to establish a public, dated record; it is not legal advice. Dual Mesh Benchmark: NOT MEASURED (out of scope). Provenance: append-only ledger, github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen. Two-key curation: drafted and vetted by the system (Gabriel), published on the owner's explicit GO (chat authorization, 2026-10-20 ~00:50 CT).
